session.title: Displaced Stumpjumper Twin Peaks aerobic-climb repeatability
session.bike: Stumpjumper Expert MY25 with established clipless system and unchanged HSC+1 baseline
session.purpose: Restore the week's protected Stumpjumper fitness/skill exposure displaced by Monday's unhealthy haze: train two-cycle climbing repeatability and controlled Pure Quill execution while preserving Friday's Enduro transfer.

dose.admission_gate: Fresh Wednesday evidence must show physical readiness green, CNS ready or normal, clarity at least 8/10, no illness, pain, gastrointestinal or respiratory symptoms, and Tuesday recovery that preserved or improved leg feel after Monday's Suito work.
dose.air_quality_gate: Check the live IQAir Taman Tun Dr. Ismail station immediately before departure. US AQI 151 or higher closes outdoor training. AQI 101-150 closes this prolonged two-cycle quality session and selects the indoor fallback. AQI 100 or lower permits consideration only if there is no visible haze, smoke odour or respiratory or eye/throat irritation. Do not coach from a daily average or forecast when a current local observation is available.
dose.weather_gate: No thunder or lightning, rapidly building cell, gust front, unsafe visibility, flowing water or unpredictable trail grip.
dose.opening_gate: Complete 10-15 minutes easy, bike and pressure checks, figure-eights both ways, deliberate front/rear loading and recentring, and two to three progressive firm stops. Processing, steering and braking timing must feel immediate and symmetric.
dose.cycle_one: Climb Twin Peaks at RPE 4, using approximately 150-165 W on uninterrupted climbable sections when terrain permits. Use natural standing on steep pitches without sprinting or grinding. Descend full Pure Quill at 70-75 percent intent with braking completed before turn-in.
dose.cycle_two_gate: Proceed only if climb one stayed at RPE 4 or lower overall, breathing and legs normalize, vision and decision speed are normal, front tracking and steering are clean, there was no rescue or near miss, and braking and upper-body fatigue are each 2/10 or lower.
dose.cycle_two: Repeat the climb at RPE 5 or lower and aim for comparable climb power within about 5 percent without forcing terrain-limited watts. Descend full Pure Quill at 75-80 percent, gaining speed only from cleaner line choice, earlier brake release and centred posture.
dose.hard_cap: Two complete Twin Peaks-to-Pure-Quill cycles, familiar egress only, 130 minutes and approximately 400-500 m climbing. No third descent, alternate stage, segment attempt, maximal standing torque, jump progression or setup change.
dose.fallback: If air quality or another admission gate fails, ride 45-60 minutes indoors at 116-130 W and RPE 2-3 only if the indoor clean-air gate is satisfactory; otherwise rest. Do not relocate this MTB session to Thursday.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: Moderate self-pedaled climbing on the Stumpjumper will develop bike-specific aerobic recovery and standing-torque economy, while two controlled familiar descents preserve perception-action timing without consuming the neural and mechanical cost reserved for Friday's Enduro exposure.
execution_rules: The primary target is climbing/aerobic repeatability; descending is controlled technical transfer, not a maximal second target.
Use external HR and power, with unchanged suspension and tyre settings.
Finish braking before turn-in, identify the exit before the apex and remain dynamically centred; no deliberate feature or flat-section attack.
Start normally fed and use the normal 90-150-minute KL heat-fueling range selected from same-day heat and sweat response.

expected_result.physiology: Cycle two climb power remains within about 5 percent where terrain permits and RPE remains 5 or lower, without grinding.
expected_result.technical: The second descent matches or improves the first for vision, line choice, brake release, front tracking and dynamic centre, with no rescue correction.
expected_result.next_day: No respiratory symptoms, late CNS cost or disproportionate leg or upper-body fatigue that threatens Friday.

stop_rules: The air-quality, readiness, CNS, symptom and weather gates are hard; feeling strong does not override them.
Do not begin cycle two after reactive braking, delayed or missed line choice, unintended deflection, rescue, near miss, narrowed vision or braking or upper-body fatigue above 2/10.
Stop intensity if the first climb exceeds RPE 5, the second exceeds RPE 6, breathing does not normalize or power requires grinding.
Stop for respiratory irritation, abnormal shortness of breath, fork pack-down or ping, rear kick or wallow, chassis pitch, or any tyre, brake, cleat or mechanical concern.
